account_sid.description: The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created the ModelBuild resource.

date_created.description: The date and time in GMT when the resource was created specified in [RFC 2822](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2822.txt) format.

date_updated.description: The date and time in GMT when the resource was last updated specified in [RFC 2822](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2822.txt) format.

assistant_sid.description: The SID of the [Assistant](https://www.twilio.com/docs/autopilot/api/assistant) that is the parent of the resource.

sid.description: The unique string that we created to identify the ModelBuild resource.

status.description: The status of the model build process. Can be: `enqueued`, `building`, `completed`, or `failed`

unique_name.description: An application-defined string that uniquely identifies the resource. It can be used as an alternative to the `sid` in the URL path to address the resource.

url.description: The absolute URL of the ModelBuild resource.

build_duration.description: The time in seconds it took to build the model.

error_code.description: If the `status` for the model build is `failed`, this value is a code to more information about the failure. This value will be null for all other statuses. See [error code dictionary](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors) for a description of the error.
